title: E-QTM-0081: the gap-resolved bulk-boundary correspondence: a chiral walk carries two independent topological...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0081 in the quantum arena: the gap-resolved bulk-boundary correspondence: a chiral walk carries two independent topological invariants (one per quasienergy gap), and an interface binds 2|delta nu0| edge modes at the 0 gap and 2|delta nuPi| at the pi gap, so an interface can bind modes at one gap and none at the other (4,0) or (0,4), matched integer-for-integer to the bulk windings computed from the Bloch Hamiltonian.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
